info.careerDescription: I have more than 20 years of experience in the software industry and have worked for major companies such as Repsol, Vodafone, Línea Directa, Banco Santander, among others. In many of these projects, I have been responsible for designing and leading the Front End architecture from scratch, which has allowed me to consolidate solid expertise in this field. My role has not only involved creating robust architectures, but also providing technical leadership to Front End development teams, establishing best practices to ensure the delivery of scalable, high-quality applications.

publications.intro: I have always been deeply grateful to all those developers who have selflessly shared their knowledge with the community. I owe a significant part of my professional training to many of them. In recent months, I have begun to share my own knowledge, thus contributing my small part to the community.

milestones.1: First Front End Architecture from scratch
